verdict.rationale: Rive's docs describe a built-in AI agent in the Editor that helps users write code, design, and animate, generating scripts, responsive layouts, data models, and animation. They also describe MCP integration so external AI tools can drive the Editor (View Models, State Machines, Layouts, Shapes), plus a CLI that lets an agent generate experiences. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the agent's natural-language command scope and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works in practice.
